description: S52 T4 (LM1, LM5): learnings.mine.show reads ONE learning inside the agent's readable set, rendered by the same function the standing learnings.forAgent door and the learning_add answer use — the row reads here exactly as every other surface reads it. An id outside the readable set, a retracted row and a never-filed id all answer the SAME sentence: the doors cannot be probed for what exists but is not yours (no oracle in success or in error, LM5's hygiene). A live row carries no retraction keys at all (LM2's omitempty discipline).

learning.body: the CSV writer builds columns from the rendered table, so a column that renders must not be filtered at export
